title: Cut query complexity in Lean
description:
A Lean 4 library, built on Mathlib and QuantumQueryComplexity, for deterministic, randomized, and quantum algorithms that access a graph only through cut queries. Every algorithm is an explicit query program fixed before the hidden graph, with its query cap, error probability, and output guarantee proved for every input.

Results include weight-independent cut sparsification following Plevrakis–Ragavan–Weinberg, randomized and deterministic weighted global minimum cut (the latter in O(n^{3/2} log^5 n) queries), randomized O(n) and quantum O(√n log^5 n) minimum cut of simple graphs following the star-contraction algorithm, near-linear minimum-cut certificates, deterministic minimum 2-respecting cuts, deterministic all-pairs minimum cuts in O(n^{5/3} log^5 n) queries, a reduction from Gomory–Hu trees to s-t minimum cuts, directed s-t and global minimum cuts through a stable implicit LP, and directed minimum-cut certificates.

Two axiom audits check every declaration of the audited modules transitively and allow only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. The file docs/COVERAGE.md records the source of each minimum-cut result, and the repository includes four preprints (papers/) whose results are formalized, each with a Lean reader that explains the statements of its headline theorems.
